title: Efficient pedestrian-level wind energy harvesting using a hybridized technology
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8280-8291
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE03460D, Paper
Gao Yu, Pengfei Ji, Xiaobo Gao, Tengfei Zhou, Shengbo Wang, Wei Gao, Hao Li, Zhong Lin Wang, Baodong Chen
To ensure universal access to modern, sustainable, and affordable energy, a pedestrian-level wind hybrid harvester (PLW, 0–2 m above ground level) coupling a triboelectric nanogenerator and electromagnetic generator is proposed.
